	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCliVendedor","Tg_ViewCliVendedor")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVendedores","Tg_Tabla","Vendedores","Clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCliVendedor.Alias
		
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.IrPrimero
		thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value)
		thisform.oLblComiGral.Caption=alltrim(Str(thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("Comision"),6,2))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.Value="TD"
		
		
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Provincia=thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Zona=thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Categoria=thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=Space(5)
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=Space(5)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcliente
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Clientes",.f.,thisform.oViewCliVendedor.Leer("Id_cliente"))
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewCliVendedor.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCliVendedor.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCliVendedor.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCliVendedor.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCliVendedor.Alias+".Razon_Social"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxclienteDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxclienteHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcategorias1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Categoria
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Categoria=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbprovincias1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Provincia
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Provincia=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(this.Value)
		thisform.oLblComiGral.Caption=alltrim(Str(thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("Comision"),6,2))
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbzonas1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Zona
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Zona=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarCliente
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComiArticulo","Tg_ViewComiArticulo")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVendedores","Tg_Tabla","Vendedores","Clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComiArticulo.Alias
		
		thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.IrPrimero
		thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value)
		thisform.oLblComiGral.Caption=alltrim(Str(thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("Comision"),6,2))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.Value="TD"
		
		
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Marca=thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Rubro=thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value
		thisform.OldId_SubRubro=thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=Space(15)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrararticulo
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Articulos",.f.,thisform.oViewComiArticulo.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComiArticulo.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComiArticulo.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComiArticulo.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComiArticulo.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComiArticulo.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComiArticulo.Alias+".Comision"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxArticuloDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxArticuloHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbmarcas1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Marca
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Marca=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbrubros1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Rubro
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Rubro=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsubrubros1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_SubRubro
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_SubRubro=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(this.Value)
		thisform.oLblComiGral.Caption=alltrim(Str(thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("Comision"),6,2))
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarArticulo
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComiCliente","Tg_ViewComiCliente")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVendedores","Tg_Tabla","Vendedores","Clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComiCliente.Alias
		
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.IrPrimero
		thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value)
		thisform.oLblComiGral.Caption=alltrim(Str(thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("Comision"),6,2))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.Value="TD"
		
		
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Provincia=thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Zona=thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Categoria=thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=Space(5)
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=Space(5)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcliente
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Clientes",.f.,thisform.oViewComiCliente.Leer("Id_cliente"))
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComiCliente.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComiCliente.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComiCliente.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComiCliente.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComiCliente.Alias+".Razon_Social"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComiCliente.Alias+".Comision"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxclienteDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxclienteHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcategorias1.filtrar
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Categoria
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Categoria=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbprovincias1.filtrar
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Provincia
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Provincia=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(this.Value)
		thisform.oLblComiGral.Caption=alltrim(Str(thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("Comision"),6,2))
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbzonas1.filtrar
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Zona
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Zona=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarCliente
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesVendedores","tg_viewconscomisionesvendedor")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"				,"tg_tabla","Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblTerminal"				,"Tg_Tabla","Terminal","Clave")
		thisform.oTblTerminal.Filtrar("Maquina='"+alltrim(oApp.Maquina)+"'")
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores"))			
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Vendedores,lAnulado
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".NomComprobante"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".NomCliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".NomVendedor"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Comision"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".BaseImponibleComprobante"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Sumar("BaseImponibleComprobante",".t."),2)
		thisform.oTbxTotalCom.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Sumar("total",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
		 	ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("Af_Vendedor<>0",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesVendedores","tg_viewcomprobantesvendartcob")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		*****Diego 24-09
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblTerminal"			,"Tg_Tabla","Terminal","Clave")
		thisform.oTblTerminal.Filtrar("Maquina='"+alltrim(oApp.Maquina)+"'")
		*****Diego 24-09
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.Tg_fechalim.value =cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		*!*	If thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sistema")=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
		*!*		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompVendedores",thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
		*!*		Else
		*!*			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompVendedores(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		*!*		
		*!*	Else
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Com_cruce"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_cruce"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores"))				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Com_cruce"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_cruce"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores"))			
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.Show()
		***Endif	
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_Vendedores,lAnulado
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.Tg_fechalim.value)
		
		***thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		*****		Parameters vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion,dFecha_limite
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Id_Sistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Nro_externo"

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		if ThisForm.Tg_fechalim.value =cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		    =fmensaceptar("Debe ingresar fecha limite para Com. de Vta ")
		    retu  
		endif
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdImprimir.Click
		Local oListado,nContador,oFrmSeleccionarImpresora,nCopias,cNombreImpresora,nHojaDeRuta,nContadorCopias,vGrabacion
		
		*thisform.oTblAux_HojadeRuta.IrPrimero
		*Do While  !thisform.oTblAux_HojadeRuta.EsEof()
		*	thisform.otblAux_HojadeRuta.Borrar()	
		*	thisform.otblAux_HojadeRuta.IrSiguiente()
		*Enddo
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		oFrmSeleccionarImpresora=CreateObject("Tg_seleccionarimpresora",1,thisform.oTblTerminal.Leer("imp_def"))
		oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.Show()
		nContadorCopias = 1
		
		If !oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.Cancela
			nCopias=oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.Copias
		*	cNombreImpresora=oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.NombreImpresora	
			cNombreImpresora=oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.oCmbImpresoras.Value
			thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.IrPrimero
		
		
					Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		*!*			thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.IrPrimero
		*!*			do while !thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.EsEof() 
		*!*		 	 if thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("Imprime")	
		*!*						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "id_sucursal"    , thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("id_sucursal"))
		*!*						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "id_sistema"     , thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("id_sistema"))
		*!*						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "id_comproba"    , thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("id_comproba"))
		*!*						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "nro_referencia" , thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("nro_referencia"))
		*!*						thisform.otblAux_HojadeRuta.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)		
		*!*						thisform.otblAux_HojadeRuta.Seleccionar 
		*!*		     endif			
		*!*			thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.IrSiguiente()
		*!*			enddo					
					 				   
		
		For nContadorCopias = 1 to nCopias 
		 			
		  
						olistado=createobject("tg_liscomivendclicob",@vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.Tg_fechalim.value)
		                ****thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
						
						If Type("oListado") = "O"
							olistado.olis=createobject("tg_listador")
							
							olistado.olis.titulo=""
							olistado.olis.salida=2
							olistado.olis.ImprimeDatosYFiltros=".f."
							olistado.olis.ImprimeFechaYHora=".f."
							olistado.olis.HojaInicial="0"
							olistado.olis.Fax=.f.
							oListado.olis.NombreImpresora=cNombreImpresora	
							
							
							olistado.listar
						Endif
						olistado=""	
				
		Next	
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.IrPrimero
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
		 	ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("cobranza",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		***ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=.f.
		****ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.f.
		****ThisForm.oCmdAvanzado.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesVendedores","tg_viewcomprobantesvendartcli")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		*****Diego 24-09
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblTerminal"			,"Tg_Tabla","Terminal","Clave")
		thisform.oTblTerminal.Filtrar("Maquina='"+alltrim(oApp.Maquina)+"'")
		*****Diego 24-09
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sistema")=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompVendedores",thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompVendedores(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores"))				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores"))			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.Show()
		Endif	
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_Vendedores,lAnulado
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdImprimir.Click
		Local oListado,nContador,oFrmSeleccionarImpresora,nCopias,cNombreImpresora,nHojaDeRuta,nContadorCopias,vGrabacion
		
		*thisform.oTblAux_HojadeRuta.IrPrimero
		*Do While  !thisform.oTblAux_HojadeRuta.EsEof()
		*	thisform.otblAux_HojadeRuta.Borrar()	
		*	thisform.otblAux_HojadeRuta.IrSiguiente()
		*Enddo
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		oFrmSeleccionarImpresora=CreateObject("Tg_seleccionarimpresora",1,thisform.oTblTerminal.Leer("imp_def"))
		oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.Show()
		nContadorCopias = 1
		
		If !oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.Cancela
			nCopias=oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.Copias
		*	cNombreImpresora=oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.NombreImpresora	
			cNombreImpresora=oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.oCmbImpresoras.Value
			thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.IrPrimero
		
		
					Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		*!*			thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.IrPrimero
		*!*			do while !thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.EsEof() 
		*!*		 	 if thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("Imprime")	
		*!*						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "id_sucursal"    , thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("id_sucursal"))
		*!*						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "id_sistema"     , thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("id_sistema"))
		*!*						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "id_comproba"    , thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("id_comproba"))
		*!*						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "nro_referencia" , thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.Leer("nro_referencia"))
		*!*						thisform.otblAux_HojadeRuta.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)		
		*!*						thisform.otblAux_HojadeRuta.Seleccionar 
		*!*		     endif			
		*!*			thisform.oViewConsHojadeRuta.IrSiguiente()
		*!*			enddo					
					 				   
		
		For nContadorCopias = 1 to nCopias 
		 			
		  
						olistado=createobject("tg_liscomivendcli",@vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		                ****thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
						
						If Type("oListado") = "O"
							olistado.olis=createobject("tg_listador")
							
							olistado.olis.titulo=""
							olistado.olis.salida=2
							olistado.olis.ImprimeDatosYFiltros=".f."
							olistado.olis.ImprimeFechaYHora=".f."
							olistado.olis.HojaInicial="0"
							olistado.olis.Fax=.f.
							oListado.olis.NombreImpresora=cNombreImpresora	
							
							
							olistado.listar
						Endif
						olistado=""	
				
		Next	
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.IrPrimero
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
		 	ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("!cobranza",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		*ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=.f.
		*ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.f.
		*ThisForm.oCmdAvanzado.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesVendedores","Tg_ViewComprobantesVendedores")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sistema")=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompVendedores",thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompVendedores(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores"))				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores"))			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.Show()
		Endif	
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_Vendedores,lAnulado
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesVendedores1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Vendedor,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".NombreSistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".NombreVendedor"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Alias+".Comision"
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesVendedores.Sumar("iif(Suma,1,-1)*Total",".t."),2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
		 	ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesvendedores1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesvendedores1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_vendedor
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores","Tg_ViewCtaCorrienteVendedores")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVendedores","tg_tabla","VEndedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbvendedores1.IrPrimero
		thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(6,7,8,9)
		
		If Type("cId_Vendedor")<>T_LOGICAL
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_CmbVendedores1.Value=cId_Vendedor
			thisform.tg_CmbVendedores1.Enabled=.f.
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.	
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.	
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.t.)
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_sistema")=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompVendedores",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompVendedores(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores"))				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores"))			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.Show()
		Endif	
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters lMoverFocus
		Local lComiFacturacion
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		lComiFacturacion=iif(ThisForm.oOpgTipoComision.Value=1,.t.,.f.)
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),lComiFacturacion)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias
				
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla(lMoverFocus)		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		lParameters lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		
		
		** Parametro intocable porque a veces no puedo hacer el setfocus cuando se hace
		** un refrescarAplicacion desde otro objeto, este no puede tomar el foco sino
		** se lo debe dejar al otro objeto sin quitarselo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".Debe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".Haber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".TotalComprobante"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.Alias+".Comision"
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		If lLlevaFocoAGrilla
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
		Endif							  
		
		thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteVendedores.IrUltimo
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-thisform.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		thisform.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(thisform.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.t.)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgTipoComision.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.InteractiveChange
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.ProgrammaticChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.InteractiveChange
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		thisform.FilaGrillaRelativa=this.RelativeRow
		*!*	thisform.FilaGrillaAbsoluta=this.ActiveRow
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column2.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column6.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column7.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column9.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		IF this.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value=1
			thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value)
			ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
			this.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Enabled=.f.
		Else
			this.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Enabled=.t.	
		Endif
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_seleccionarcomprobantesvendedores AS tg_lstselevariositems OF "tg_varios.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<PropValue>
		Name = "tg_seleccionarcomprobantesvendedores"
		Tg_listbox1.ColumnWidths = "15,30,190,60"
		Tg_listbox1.Name = "Tg_listbox1"
		Tg_3dshape1.Name = "Tg_3dshape1"
		oChkMarcaTodo.Name = "oChkMarcaTodo"
		Tg_label1.Caption = "Comprobantes"
		Tg_label1.Name = "Tg_label1"
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cFiltro,lMarcarTodo
		Local mmpp
		
		dodefault()
		this.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		this.AddObject("oTblVnd_Docu","Tg_tabla","Vnd_Docu","Clave")
		
		If Type("cFiltro")=T_CHARACTER
			this.oTblVnd_Docu.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		Endif
		
		IF This.oTblParametros.Leer("OrdenNombreSelccionComprobantes")
			this.oTblVnd_Docu.FijarTag("Nombre")
			this.oTblVnt_Docu.FijarTag("Nombre")		
		Endif
		
		
		
		this.oTblVnd_Docu.IrPrimero
		mmpp=0
		Do while !this.oTblVnd_Docu.EsEof()
			If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",this.oTblVnd_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	,"C" ,oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")) or !this.FiltraComprobantesEnConsultasPorPermisos
		
				mmpp=mmpp+1
				this.tg_listbox1.AddItem(space(5),mmpp,1)
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,2)=this.oTblVnd_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,3)=this.oTblVnd_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,4)="Vendedores"
				
				
				Dimension this.vItems[mmpp,2]
				this.vItems[mmpp,1]=this.oTblVnd_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")+oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")	
				this.vItems[mmpp,2]=.f.
			Endif
			this.oTblVnd_Docu.IrSiguiente
			
		Enddo
		
		this.oTblVnt_Docu.Filtrar("Af_Vendedor<>0")
		
		Do while !this.oTblVnt_Docu.EsEof()
			If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	,"C" ,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) or !this.FiltraComprobantesEnConsultasPorPermisos
		
				mmpp=mmpp+1
				this.tg_listbox1.AddItem(space(5),mmpp,1)
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,2)=this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,3)=this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,4)="Ventas"	
				
				Dimension this.vItems[mmpp,2]
				this.vItems[mmpp,1]=this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")+oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")		
				this.vItems[mmpp,2]=.f.
				
			Endif	
			this.oTblVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente
			
		Enddo
		
		
		
		this.tg_listbox1.Listindex=1
		If lMarcarTodo
			this.MarcarTodo
		Endif
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
